name: ANAC 2019
description: It reports the challenges, protocols, and results of the Automated Negotiating Agents Competition 2019, which evaluates automated negotiation agents.
typical_sota_score: varies by negotiation domain and utility function; top agents in ANAC editions typically report normalized utilities in the approximate range ~0.6–0.95
notes: Non-LLM benchmark centered on strategic negotiation; outcomes depend heavily on protocol, domain, and opponent behavior, making scores hard to compare across tracks.
